entries.069c1a9031dcfe64: An electrical equipment manufacturer that makes and sells power devices, electrical components, and power supply units.
entries.47eb03fdd55d0f79: It manufactures diodes, thyristors, power MOSFETs, power ICs, power modules and other products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥33,490 million. The main companies are the company, Akita Shindengen Co., Ltd., Higashine Shindengen Co., Ltd., Hadano Shindengen Co., Ltd., Lamphun Shindengen Company Limited, Shindengen Philippines Corporation and Kaohsiung Shindengen Electronics Co., Ltd.
entries.6fc7ddd2f78843c6: This is the solenoid business and other operations not included in reportable segments. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥129 million.
